verdict.rationale: Breach and incident response is a fair axis for a law firm with a data privacy practice, so the story applies. The firm's data privacy page documents only privacy policies, security-related contractual provisions and CIPP headcount. It does not document security-incident or breach response, or regulator-facing work. Contract drafting is an adjacent capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm handles security-incident and breach response, including regulator-facing work, documented on its own pages
